import itertools
# universe elements as types over (P,O,B,Pl); enumerate models
types=list(itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4))
valid=[t for t in types if (not t[1] or t[2]) and (not t[2] or t[3])]
res=None
ok=[True,True,True]
for r in range(1<<len(valid)):
    S=[valid[i] for i in range(len(valid)) if r>>i&1]
    if not any(t[0] and t[1] for t in S): continue
    c1=any(t[0] and t[3] for t in S)
    c2=all(t[3] for t in S if t[1])
    c3=not any(t[0] and t[2] for t in S)
    ok[0]&=c1;ok[1]&=c2;ok[2]&=c3
assert ok==[True,True,False]
o={'A':(1,3),'B':(2,3),'C':(1,2),'D':(3,)}
